# Resolved tokens per theme

Every CSS custom property `themeToCss()` writes, per theme. Use this to answer "what is --X in theme Y". Themes in order: fabrik, illuzion, laroc, bootshaus, berghain, savaya, pacha, amnesia, ushuaia.
